labels.text: Update billing to restore Managed Cloud chat.

S83.14.needs: a paid account whose subscription is past due (a Free account cannot reach this)
S83.14.note: The extension only handles past_due and other non-active subscription statuses in the chat gate (side_panel.ts around line 13434). I found no wording for a failed checkout payment in apps/extension/src or _locales/en/messages.json (searched for payment failure, checkout error and card declined), so the checkout part of Expected is not covered in the extension. The Code line's freeTrialClient.ts:269 is the managed-access request that raises the refusal; it has no user-visible payment text.
steps: Sign in to the AGI side panel with an account whose paid subscription is past due (payment failed at renewal).
Open the chat in the side panel and look at the composer area where the Managed Cloud gate appears.
Read the message. It should say "Update billing to restore Managed Cloud chat." (for other non-active statuses it says "Your subscription is <status>. Update billing to restore Managed Cloud chat.").
Check that a new browser tab opens on the billing settings page (/settings/billing) so the user can fix the payment, and that the message matches Expected.
S83.14.where: Side panel > chat composer gate (shown when the paid subscription is past due or otherwise not active) > Manage billing
